target.title: fix: reject Telegram topic sessions_send targets before dispatch
target.body:
Closes #99835

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where `sessions_send` could accept a Telegram topic child session key, such as `agent:main:telegram:group:-100123:topic:77`, before the Telegram channel plugin was loaded in the current process. That allowed the tool to continue toward inter-agent dispatch instead of returning the existing thread-target rejection that tells callers to use the parent channel session key.

## Why This Change Was Made

The `sessions_send` direct-target guard now uses the full session thread-info resolver, which can consult plugin-owned lightweight `session-key-api` artifacts before falling back to generic `:thread:` parsing. This keeps the Telegram topic grammar owned by the Telegram plugin boundary without importing the full Telegram runtime into the agent tool path.

AI-assisted: yes, implemented and validated with Codex.

## User Impact

Users and agents now get the intended actionable error when they accidentally target a Telegram topic child session with `sessions_send`. The correct parent target remains `agent:main:telegram:group:-100123`.

## Evidence

- Before the code change, the new focused regression test failed with `Expected: "error"` and `Received: "accepted"` for `agent:main:telegram:group:-100123:topic:77`.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/tools/sessions.test.ts src/channels/plugins/session-conversation.test.ts src/channels/plugins/session-conversation.bundled-fallback.test.ts`
  - Passed: `src/agents/tools/sessions.test.ts` 44 tests, session-conversation tests 9 tests.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/tools/sessions-send-tool.ts src/agents/tools/sessions.test.ts`
  - Passed.
- `git diff --check`
  - Passed.
- `node scripts/tsdown-build.mjs`
  - Passed.
- Source runtime micro-probe using the real `createSessionsSendTool` and real Telegram `session-key-api` fallback with the Telegram plugin not loaded:
  - Returned `status: "error"` and `sessions_send cannot target a thread session for inter-agent coordination. Use the parent channel session key instead.`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`
  - Clean: no accepted/actionable findings.
